entities.description: A character Edgar offers to settle a matter with by a coin toss.

entities.description: A character who prays for the Water Crystal to regain its light.

entities.description: A crystal whose light has faded.

entities.description: Bartz's chocobo companion.

entities.description: A character who believes they can save Cocoon.

entities.name: fal'Cie

entities.description: Weapons called the pinnacle of perfection.

entities.description: The ultimate sword, used by a legendary king and forged in another world.

entities.name: Maria
entities.description: A person someone is said to be the spitting image of.

entities.name: Lindblum
entities.description: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.

entities.name: Midgar
entities.description: A city that is a triumph of technology.

entities.name: Lightning
entities.description: A character who compares herself to lightning that only destroys.

entities.name: Noctis

entities.name: Yuna
entities.description: A character whose journey ends at Zanarkand.

entities.name: Zanarkand
entities.description: A city dead for a thousand years and the end of Yuna's journey.

events.summary: Minwu chooses to remain behind to care for the wounded.
events.quote: I shall remain here and devote myself to the care of the wounded.

events.summary: Locke Cole thanks the moogles for their help.
events.quote: Thanks, moogles! We're in your debt!

events.summary: Gaius van Baelsar is horrified by the unintended devastation of Ultima.
events.quote: Such devastation ... this was not my intention!

events.summary: Alisaie Leveilleur bids farewell to her grandfather Louisoix after his sacrifice.
events.quote: Pray take your rest, Grandfather... You deserve it.

events.summary: The elder primal Odin returns to Eorzea.
events.quote: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

events.summary: Maduin chooses the name Terra for a child.
events.quote: I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra.

events.summary: The Seventh Astral Era is proclaimed.
events.quote: The Seventh Astral Era is come!
